Leo (Engineer): Heads up  corpcard charge for $95.20 shows as "TRANSPORTATION NETWORK CO" MCC 4121. I used Lyft to go to the airport but receipt has multiple legs and surge. The ride was pre-approved by manager in email. How do I submit so it codes to travel?
Ava (Finance): Do you have the ride itemized receipt? If the vendor consolidates multiple legs into one total, include a short note describing each leg (pickup -> airport, time, fare breakdown) and attach manager approval.
Leo (Engineer): I only have the emailed receipt from Lyft, shows total + map. Manager reply in thread: "ok to travel" (Nora).
Nora (People Ops): Confirmed I replied ok. For future airport runs please use the travel portal ground transport flow, but this is fine.
ChargeBot: :warning: Policy check failed  multi-leg fare needs memo for reconciliation. Expense ID: CHG-4121-2026
Ava (Finance): Filing instructions: submit in Expensify under Transportation > Ride Share. In notes add manager approval quote and a short breakdown (leg A: $32.10, leg B surge: $63.10). Code to GL 6120-Travel-Local. Attach screenshot of Lyft email + manager approval. We'll approve once note+attachments present.
Leo (Engineer): Done  uploaded receipt + Nora approval screenshot. Submitted: https://expensify.com/receipt/RE-240001
Ava (Finance): Received. Marking as pending review. If bank later flags vendor MCC, we'll follow up with card provider. Thanks.
notes: Include ride breakdown and manager approval screenshot when submitting
